en: A black-and-white postcard view of a riverside promenade lined with multi‑storey historic buildings and trees. Behind the city rises a steep, wooded hill topped with fortification walls and buildings; on the right side of the hill stands a prominent clock tower. In the foreground, signage on the buildings includes a café and various shops. The caption along the bottom border identifies the scene as Graz, showing the Schlossberg hill and the Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Kai embankment.
